item_chain: AtumItems.ITEM_DEFERRED -> Atum modBus -> 8 named artifact items / HELMET,CHESTPLATE,LEGGINGS,BOOTS / NEBU -> RaArmor or AtemArmor -> ArtifactArmor -> TexturedArmorItem -> ArmorItem
worn_chain: initializeClient.getHumanoidArmorModel -> fresh bakeLayer RA_ARMOR/ATEM_ARMOR registered ClientHandler -> customModel(slot,hasFullSet) -> ArmorModel(HumanoidModel)
texture: setHasRender=true -> TexturedArmorItem.getArmorTexture same <ra|atem>_armor.png all slots/type; not standard layer1/layer2 and not DyeableLeatherItem
context_limit: ModelPart反编译上下文来自历史MCP/Forge缓存，不是NeoForm154220逐class同源证明；Neo补丁和扩展源码单独固定。
pose_visibility: Neo parent copy and slot visibility before getArmorModelHook; IClientItemExtensions generic copies pose and 7 part visibility to replacement. Custom render overrides masks: head HEAD, body+arms CHEST, legs LEGS, boots FEET, hat false. Cape visible hasFullSet independently of slot.
full_set: StackHelper compares four actual slot item objects against four specific family getters. No guessed NBT variant.
pass_limit: Cape manually rendered whenever hasFullSet in each equipment model invocation; whole diagnostic union renders once, does not simulate up to four base invocations or trim/glint extra invocations. This is a static call-path risk, not observed runtime failure.
event_limit: RenderPlayerEvent.Post visibility changes occur after player render; no claim they hide same-frame skin in advance. Atem constructor EVENT_BUS registration read, runtime effects untested.
model_algorithm: AST parses constant arithmetic, UV/mirror/deformation/PartPose; hierarchy T*Rz*Ry*Rx; inflated cube vertices, mirror X swap + polygon order reversal. Actual custom cape/boot copyFrom applied before neutral rendering.
